comment: Local CVE database for Pardus Kernel Swap. A kernel base version V is considered affected by an entry when: introduced <= V < fixed (version comparison via dpkg --compare-versions). Set 'fixed' to null for an unpatched issue (affected for every V >= introduced).

cves.description: Use-after-free in the netfilter nf_tables subsystem allowing local privilege escalation.
cves.recommendation: Upgrade to a 6.12 LTS kernel >= 6.12.80, or move to a newer supported branch.

cves.description: Out-of-bounds write in the KSMBD server reachable from authenticated SMB sessions.
cves.recommendation: Upgrade to a kernel >= 6.18.10 or disable the in-kernel SMB server.

cves.description: Race condition in the io_uring completion path leading to a NULL pointer dereference and local DoS.
cves.recommendation: Upgrade to the Stable 7.0.12 kernel or newer.

cves.description: Integer overflow in the AMDGPU display code reachable from an unprivileged DRM ioctl.
